tests.name: Dynamic Date Token Mutation & Evaluation (Suite Timezone)
tests.description: Demonstrates suite-level timezone (Africa/Johannesburg) with dynamic date tokens in request mutations and response assertions.

assertions.description: Effective date must equal current date + 15 days
Effective date must be after today
Current date must be recognized as today

tests.name: Dynamic Date Range Assertion with Bounded Tokens
tests.description: Validates DATE_BETWEEN using dynamic min and max token expressions.

assertions.description: Effective date falls within dynamic window (today to +20d)
Current date matches current date expression

tests.name: Test-Case Specific Timezone Override (Asia/Tokyo)
tests.description: Demonstrates test-case-level timezone override (Asia/Tokyo), overriding the suite-level timezone.

assertions.description: Effective date equals +5 days evaluated in Tokyo timezone
Effective date is in the future relative to Tokyo today

tests.name: Test-Case Specific Timezone Override (America/New_York)
tests.description: Demonstrates test-case-level timezone override (America/New_York) with dynamic past date mutations and comparisons.

assertions.description: Effective date is in the past relative to New York today
Effective date matches exact -30d dynamic token

tests.name: Calendar Boundary & Time Expression Tokens Test
tests.description: Demonstrates calendar boundary and time expression tokens.

assertions.description: Effective date equals start of month
Effective date is within current year boundary
Start of month is before first day of next month
